title: Page icons — a house for Home

steps.path: Pinned Home button and the Home page’s top strip
steps.headline: Home has its own house icon, in the app’s outline style.
steps.changed: A custom house drawing replaces the generic document icon. It uses the same line weight, rounded ends and theme colour as the surrounding app icons.
steps.notice: The pin and page title identify Home at a glance. New Pages will carry their own purpose-designed artwork rather than being restricted to stock icons.
steps.risk: The installed app needs an update to display custom artwork; older versions keep a fallback icon.

steps.headline: Check the house at its normal size in the top bar.
steps.hint: Open Home from its house icon. Check the page’s title, return to chat, and compare it with the neighbouring icons. This is an isolated preview, not your installed app.
steps.notice: The artwork belongs to the Page; the app supplies the consistent outline style and theme colour.
